The main takeaway from our work is that
sign controllability is a property which can easily be verified for linear time-invariant control systems.
sign controllability can be decided in polynomial time if the sign pattern of A has at most one eigenvalue of multiplicity 2, or at most two eigenvalues of multiplicity 3.
